If the tech lead wants the unbounded proof, a follow-up task should add a single formal_spec (rr_arbiter.sby, mode prove, no [tasks]) reading rr_arbiter.v with -formal. The N=5 proof would need a separate job, because only one formal_spec is accepted per run.
